thesis: The page is a panel schedule that fills itself in: two columns of numbered circuits flip from OFF to ON as you scroll, and each live circuit opens into a service, a tool or a review written in the same hand that labels lugs.

signature.name: Panel Schedule Flip
signature.summary: Two-column rail of numbered breaker slots with amperage pills and handwritten labels; handles flip OFF→ON on scroll entry, labels draw in via clip-path wipe. Reused in hero mosaic, service cards, review filing, and footer main-off slot.

palette.family: Breaker Charcoal + Panel Cream + Amber ON

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles unclip top-to-bottom with 80ms stagger; headline fades in at 600ms. Skippable via reduced motion.
stories: Circuit handle rotates 90deg OFF→ON with 200ms ease-out snap; label draws in via clip-path wipe left-to-right over 400ms.
Amperage number counts up from 0 to calculated load using data-count, tabular numerals, 900ms.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left (scaleX 0→1, transform-origin left, 200ms) on all interactive elements.
